housing-numbers.notes: Structure plan requirement was 5,600 homes for 1996-2011; 980 completed 1996-2000, leaving 4,620 for 2000-2011. Plan proposes 5,052 dwellings total for flexibility. Committed housing includes 1,893 with planning permission as of April 2000 (318 on small sites + 1,575 on larger sites). Windfall is re-use of existing buildings and previously developed land outside urban areas.
